newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt Inc Q2 Dec 31 net up.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt Inc Q2 Dec 31 net up.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Included in discontinued operations for quarter and six months ended December 31, 1995, are earnings, net of tax, from divested Feed Ingredients business of $1.0 million and $5.5 million, respectively. Discontinued operations reflect after-tax gain of $34.4 million on sale of Feed Ingredients business and provision for additional environmental costs. Included in earnings from continuing operations for six months ended December 31, 1996, is one-time research and development charge of $6.0 million, $3.8 million after taxes or $0.05 per share resulting from strategic alliance to develop new magnetic resonance imaging technology.
